The '''Maintenance Transport Tunnels''' were a series of underground maintenance tunnels that supported the [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertram]] system of the [[Old World]], of the planet [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Senya Tirall]], [[T7-O1]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] infiltrated Zakuul via the [[Tram Pump Station 726]], passing the tunnels on their way to the Old World surface during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maintenance Transport Tunnels appear as an area on Zakuul during "Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
